title: Data leak: Careers360 about 3.6 million records compromised, verified listing
content_md:
Data leak: Careers360 (careers360.com), listed as verified. Approximately 3.6 million records compromised. Data types listed: academic records, caste, email addresses, gender, and two more categories. The date field is truncated in the post at 2026-1. Source: https://beesint.com/pulse/5dfae4d2-1a70-42fb-987f-741b30385c3f

via Mastodon https://beesint.com/pulse/5dfae4d2-1a70-42fb-987f-741b30385c3f
exclude_reason: Second social teaser for the same 3.6M-record Careers360 claim; no existing story and no primary source detail.
